messages.english: Enter weekly harvest targets and your produce-pack weights in kilograms or pounds.
messages.translation: Kenya lipakane tsa kotulo tsa beke le beke le boima ba hau ba liphuthelwana tsa kotulo ka lik'hilograma (kg) kapa liponto tsa boima (lb).

messages.english: Keep buyer entries when a save cannot be confirmed.
messages.translation: Boloka lintlha tsa litlhoko tsa bareki tseo u li kentseng li ntse li le teng ha ho boloka ho sa khone ho netefatsoa.
Khetha li-unit tsa boima ba kotulo
Moralo oa tlhahiso → Lipakane tsa kotulo

messages.english: Choose kilograms or pounds, enter your harvest target or your own pack weight, then save. Unknown pack weights stay missing; target totals are planning estimates.
messages.translation: Khetha lik'hilograma (kg) kapa liponto tsa boima (lb), kenya pakane ea hau ea kotulo kapa boima boo u bo lekantseng ba sephuthelwana sa kotulo, ebe u a boloka. Boima ba liphuthelwana bo sa tsejoeng bo lula bo le sieo; kakaretso ea lipakane ke likhakanyo tsa moralo feela.
